treaty_name: Convention between the Kingdom of Denmark and the Republic of Poland for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital (2001, as amended 2009)
eif_quote: Overenskomsten trådte i medfør af artikel 28 i kraft den 31. december 2002.
source_title: BKI nr 2 af 09/01/2003 (convention, DA) + BKI nr 65 af 21/12/2010 (protocol 7.12.2009, arts 22 and 25 only)

rates.quote: a) 0 pct. af bruttobeløbet af udbyttet, hvis den retmæssige ejer er et selskab (bortset fra et interessentskab), som direkte ejer mindst 25 pct. af kapitalen i det selskab, som udbetaler udbyttet, og har ejet denne del af kapitalen i en uafbrudt periode på mindst et år, og udbyttet fastsættes inden for denne periode;
c) 15 pct. af bruttobeløbet af udbyttet i alle andre tilfælde.

2. Sådanne renter kan dog også beskattes i den kontraherende stat, hvorfra den hidrører og i overensstemmelse med lovgivningen i denne stat, men hvis den retmæssige ejer af renten er hjemmehørende i den anden kontraherende stat, må den således pålagte skat ikke overstige 5 pct. af bruttobeløbet af renterne.

2. Sådanne royalties kan dog også beskattes i den kontraherende stat, hvorfra de hidrører og i overensstemmelse med lovgivningen i denne stat, men hvis den retmæssige ejer af royaltybeløbet er hjemmehørende i den anden kontraherende stat, må den således pålagte skat ikke overstige 5 pct. af bruttobeløbet af royaltybeløbet.

ppt.quote: 1. Notwithstanding any provisions of a Covered Tax Agreement, a benefit under the Covered Tax Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of the Covered Tax Agreement.

notes: Signed in Danish, Polish and English; English prevails in case of doubt - quotes from the official Danish text (English not fetched). Art. 28(2): effect for the income year following the year of entry into force -> 2003-01-01. Dividend 0% tier requires >=25% direct holding for an uninterrupted period of at least one year (treaty condition, modelled as 365 days); 10(2)(b) 5% for recognised pension funds not modelled. Interest exempt at source (art. 11(3)) for loans granted/guaranteed by State-owned financial institutions, credit sales of equipment, government bonds, and interest paid to the other State - not modelled. 2009 Protocol (in force 2010-11-25) only replaces art. 22 (elimination of double taxation) and art. 25 (exchange of information). MLI: covered by both, WHT effective 2020-01-01 (treaty map). MLI art. 8 does not apply: Poland reserved under art. 8(3)(b)(i) for treaties already containing a minimum holding period, listing Denmark Article 10(2)(a). No art. 35(7) reservation.
